description.en: Build cyberpunk parkour scenes with smooth motion and camera moves.

prompt.zh: 使用After Effects复刻参考视频，要求各个画面元素可编辑，时长和比例需要和参考视频相同

description.en: Create mirrored fractals that morph smoothly to the rhythm of music.
description.zh: 以音乐驱动左右镜像的分形网格，在黑白几何形态间流畅变形，呈现实时音画交互。

prompt.en: Use TouchDesigner to turn the music @暗黑重音-30秒循环.wav into a real-time audiovisual interaction: use a pure black background and a centered subject, with fine black, white, and gray lines, translucent grids, and a few particles moving along the lines to form strictly left-right mirrored fractal geometry. In response to the music, continuously morph back and forth between rounded, loose four-way elliptical grids and tight, sharp X shapes, diamonds, and radiating crystals. Make the overall opening, closing, stretching, twisting, and gathering clearly visible, while keeping transitions silky smooth, without rigid bouncing or sudden cuts. Maintain a cold, mysterious digital-art aesthetic. Use a 16:9 landscape format and loop the music. Visual reference: @对称翼状分形.png
prompt.zh: 用 TouchDesigner 把这段音乐@暗黑重音-30秒循环.wav 做成实时音画交互：纯黑背景，主体居中，以黑白灰细密线条、半透明网格和少量沿线粒子构成严格左右镜像的分形几何，随音乐在圆润松散的四向椭圆网格与紧密尖锐的 X 形、菱形、放射晶体之间持续往复变形，整体开合、拉伸、扭转和聚拢要明显，但过渡丝滑、不生硬弹跳、不突然切换，保持冷峻、神秘的数字艺术感，采用 16:9 横屏并循环播放音乐。视觉参考@对称翼状分形.png

description.en: Recreate castle destruction and running characters with procedural modeling, fracture dynamics, and orbiting camera moves.
description.zh: 通过 Houdini 程序化建模与破碎动力学，复刻古堡崩解、人物奔跑与环绕运镜。

prompt.en:
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1WP4y1w73v?spm_id_from=333.788.player.player_end_recommend_autoplay&vd_source=3b559ff67aecc6e262d929cea7c2fcc5&trackid=web_related_0.router-related-2589621-bzdpg.1788855534517.769

prompt.en: Open Unreal Engine and create a forest path scene. Add trees, ground, and morning mist to create the effect of early morning sunlight filtering through the woods.

description.en: A cyber-rap portrait built from red-black fractures, zine collage, industrial rhythm, and a consistent identity.
description.zh: 以红黑裂纹、杂志拼贴与工业节拍，塑造身份稳定的赛博说唱人像。

prompt.en: Use the uploaded reference image as the sole first frame to generate a 15-second, 16:9, 24fps photorealistic dark-pop/cyber-grunge/rap MV with MiniMax H3. Strictly preserve the subject’s facial features, wet black curly hair, frontal composition, black-and-red color scheme, and the huge red text “MiniMax H3” in the background. The text must be spelled correctly. Red cracks, molten textures, and black particles gradually appear on the right side of the subject’s face, while the left side remains in deep black shadow. The subject must maintain direct eye contact with the camera and retain the same identity throughout. The overall aesthetic draws from 1990s underground music magazines and zine collages, with coarse 16mm film grain, halftone patterns, scan misregistration, color registration offsets, and ink splashes. Use only hard cuts, jump cuts, and single-frame inserts. Do not use fades or dissolves. 0–3 seconds: static, oppressive tension. 3–6 seconds: scanning and tearing. 6–10 seconds: bodily deconstruction. 10–13 seconds: energy eruption. 13–15 seconds: freeze into a cover image and push in. Retain the low-frequency synthesizer, 808 bass, industrial impacts, tape noise, and close-up breathing. From 10–13 seconds, the subject says in a deep voice, “This is H3.” Do not allow facial drift, garbled text, additional people, cheap neon effects, rainbow glitches, blood or internal organs, monster transformation, or cartoon rendering. The prompt must not be rewritten or weakened.
prompt.zh: 使用上传参考图作为唯一首帧，调用 MiniMax H3 生成 15 秒、16:9、24fps 写实 dark-pop/cyber-grunge/rap 音乐短片。严格保持人物五官、湿润黑色卷发、正面构图、黑红配色及背景巨大红色文字“MiniMax H3”，文字必须拼写正确。人物右脸逐渐出现红色裂纹、熔融纹理和黑色颗粒，左脸处于深黑阴影，始终直视镜头、身份不变。整体采用 90 年代地下音乐杂志、zine 拼贴、16mm 粗颗粒、半色调、扫描错位、套色偏移和墨迹飞溅；只用硬切、跳切、单帧插入，不用淡入淡出或叠化。按 0–3 秒静止压迫、3–6 秒扫描撕裂、6–10 秒身体解构、10–13 秒能量爆发、13–15 秒封面定格推进。保留低频合成器、808、工业撞击、磁带噪声和近距离呼吸；10–13 秒人物低沉说“This is H3.”。禁止脸部漂移、乱码、额外人物、廉价霓虹、彩虹故障、血液内脏、怪物化和卡通渲染。提示词不得被改写或弱化。

description.en: A stylish music short blending the reference character with surreal, sky-bending environments and fluid motion.
description.zh: 融合角色参考与超现实天空变形，呈现炫酷而连贯的时尚音乐短片。

prompt.en: Generated by minimax h3, a 15-second music video in 16:9, cool mv. Figure 1 is the character reference, Figure 2 and Figure 3 are the style environment reference.
prompt.zh: minimax h3生成，16:9的15秒音乐短片，炫酷mv。图1为角色参考，图2和图3为风格环境参考。

description.en: Moving clothes and rain-soaked reflections make the creature feel truly present on the balcony.
description.zh: 衣物遮挡与雨后反光都对，小生物像真在阳台里。

prompt.en: Minimax h3 generation, 15s, 16:9, a combination of real-life photography and hand-painting. On the balcony of a residential building in the evening after the rain, through the camera of my mobile phone, I discovered a small hand-painted luminous creature hiding between the flower pot and the clothes.
prompt.zh: minimax h3生成，15s，16:9，真人实拍与手绘结合。 雨后傍晚的居民楼阳台上，透过手机摄像头，发现某个躲藏在花盆和衣物之间的手绘发光小生物，躲藏在花盆和衣物之间。

description.en: Morning light, dark corners, and handheld focus make the creature feel at home in a real entryway.
description.zh: 晨光、暗部与手持对焦自然变化，小生物真的藏进玄关。

prompt.en: minimax h3 generation, 12s, 16:9, a combination of real-life photography and hand-painting. In the early morning, through the camera of my mobile phone, I saw a small hand-painted luminous creature peeking out from under the shoe cabinet in the entrance hall and quietly dragging away a fallen button.
prompt.zh: minimax h3生成，12s，16:9，真人实拍与手绘结合。 清晨，透过手机摄像头，看到一只手绘发光小生物正从玄关的鞋柜下面探出来，悄悄拖走一枚掉落纽扣。

description.en: A raindrop becomes a fish, a paper boat, and a bird, with reflections and layering that feel real.
description.zh: 雨滴变成鱼、纸船与小鸟，倒影和遮挡全跟得上。

prompt.en: Minimax h3 generation, 15s, 16:9, a combination of real-life photography and hand-painting. In the evening, a real bus stop was photographed with a mobile phone. The photographer stretched his hand out of the awning, and the rain fell on his palm, turning into a hand-drawn tadpole. It jumped into a puddle on the ground and turned into a small orange fish. The small fish jumped up and turned into a green paper boat. The paper boat hit the glass and turned into a light yellow bird. The bird flew up along the glass, flew to the old bus route map, and turned into a slowly extending glowing line on the route map.
prompt.zh: minimax h3生成，15s，16:9，真人实拍与手绘结合。 傍晚，真实的公交车站，透过手机拍摄，拍摄者把手伸到雨棚外，雨水落在掌心，变成了手绘的一只小蝌蚪，跳进地面水洼变成橙色小鱼，小鱼跃起变成一只绿色纸船，纸船撞到玻璃变成淡黄色小鸟，小鸟沿着玻璃向上飞，飞到旧公交路线图上，变成路线图上缓慢延伸的发光线路。

description.en: Ink, beetle, paper crane, and forest transformations stay true to the page perspective.
description.zh: 从墨滴到纸鹤再到森林，纸面透视始终准确。

prompt.en: Minimax h3 generation, 15s, 16:9, a combination of real-life photography and hand-painting. The old wooden table in the study room holds open notebooks and various supplies, which is very lifelike. The pen dropped a drop of blue ink onto the notebook and turned into a small beetle of colored pencils. It climbed onto a piece of yellow note paper and turned into a paper crane. The paper crane flew up and landed in the open old book, turning into a small green tree. The branches and leaves spread to become a hand-painted forest. Luminous leaves flew out of the forest and finally landed in the palm of the photographer.
prompt.zh: minimax h3生成，15s，16:9，真人实拍与手绘结合。 书房内的旧木桌放着摊开的笔记本和各种用品，很有生活气息。钢笔滴下一滴蓝色墨水到笔记本上，变成了彩铅小甲虫，爬到一张黄色便签纸上变成了千纸鹤，千纸鹤飞起落在摊开的旧书里，变成一棵绿色的小树，枝叶扩散变为手绘森林，森林里飞出发光叶子最后落在拍摄者手心。

description.en: One take carries each transformation across a hand, curved glass, and real water.
description.zh: 一镜串起掌心、玻璃与水面，连续变形不穿帮。

prompt.en: Minimax h3 generation, 15s, 16:9, a combination of real-life photography and hand-painting. A small flower shop at dusk, with light rain falling outside the glass door. Through the mobile phone camera, I see one of the photographer's hands with the palm facing up. Green hand-painted seeds appear and grow into green buds. The buds turn into hand-painted butterflies. The butterflies fall on the water surface of the stainless steel bucket and turn into small blue fish. The photographer's fingers stir the sleep, and the small fish jumps up and turns into a paper bird, and finally turns into a green leaf. The photographer attached it to the glass door and spread it out into a sea of ​​hand-painted flowers.
prompt.zh: minimax h3生成，15s，16:9，真人实拍与手绘结合。 黄昏的小花店，玻璃门外下着小雨。透过手机摄像头，看到拍摄者的一只手，掌心朝上，绿色的手绘种子出现，长成绿色的嫩芽，嫩芽变成手绘蝴蝶，蝴蝶落在不锈钢水桶的水面上变成蓝色小鱼，拍摄者手指搅动睡眠，小鱼跃起变成纸鸟，最后变成一片绿叶子。拍摄者将它贴到玻璃门上，向外扩散成手绘花海。

description.en: Glowing hand-drawn creatures transform through a real kitchen before blooming into a lively illustrated garden.
description.zh: 让发光手绘生物在真实厨房中连续变形，最终铺展成生机盎然的涂鸦花园。

prompt.en: View of the lively kitchenette. A green bud sprouts from the photographer's palm, turns into a blue-green caterpillar, and then into a paper airplane. Paper airplanes spun in the air and turned into goldfish, ribbon-like streams of water and tiny snails. The snail shyly retreats into its shell, turning into an orange swirl. The vortex spread, turning the entire kitchen into grass graffiti, and outside the window, a vast hand-painted garden spread out. A single glowing petal was stuck to the lens and removed by the photographer.
prompt.zh: 充满生机的小厨房的景色。一颗绿色的芽从摄影师的手掌中长出，变成一条蓝绿色的毛毛虫，然后变成一架纸飞机。纸飞机在空中旋转，变成了金鱼、丝带般的水流和小蜗牛。蜗牛害羞地退回到壳里，变成橙色的漩涡。漩涡蔓延，将整个厨房变成了草地涂鸦，窗外，一片广阔的手绘花园铺展开来。单个发光花瓣粘在镜头上并被摄影师移除。

description.en: A crayon-textured midnight laundromat adventure where a jellyfish, sock, fish, and train transform in sequence.
description.zh: 在深夜洗衣房中串联水母、袜子、小鱼与火车的蜡笔质感奇幻变形。

prompt.en: 15 seconds 16:9 horizontal screen short film, late night laundromat, real shot superimposed with hand-drawn luminous animation with crayon texture and jittery lines, shot handheld on a mobile phone. A wisp of purple silk thread at the fingertips → Purple crayon jellyfish → Escaped into the laundry column and turned into hand-painted socks → The hand-painted socks jumped up and down and bumped into real socks, turning into purple-blue meteors → Sliding into the washing machine and turning into light blue fish → Turning into a light blue train, touching the vending machine button → Transforming into a clip robot with purple and light blue hand-painted patterns. The entire laundry became graffiti in the night sky, and the round window of the washing machine turned into a blinking constellation window. The last hand-painted sock falls into the laundry basket.
prompt.zh: 15秒16:9横屏短片，深夜自助洗衣店，实拍叠加蜡笔质感抖动线条的手绘发光动画，手机手持拍摄。 指尖一缕紫色丝线→紫色蜡笔水母→逃窜到洗衣栏里，变成手绘袜子→手绘袜子一蹦一跳撞上真实袜子，变成紫蓝色流星→滑进洗衣机，变成浅蓝色小鱼→变成浅蓝色小火车，触碰售货机按键→变成夹子机器人，紫色与淡蓝色手绘纹路铺满开。 整间洗衣店变成夜空涂鸦，洗衣机圆形视窗化作闪烁的星座窗口。 最后一只手绘袜子坠落到洗衣篮内。

description.zh: 以空间重建、艺术字体与产品特写，突出耳机结构、材质和潮流质感。

prompt.en: Make a font packaging video for headphones, H3 video model generation, cool artistic style, product packaging, overhead reconstruction of packaging space, 15 seconds, 3:4 vertical format, 2K, retain the product shape, material and structure, and use pure English for screen text.
prompt.zh: 做一个头戴耳机的字体包装视频，H3视频模型生成，炫酷艺术风，产品包装，架空重建包装空间，15秒，2K，保留产品外形、材质和结构，屏幕文字用纯英文。

description.en: Gen Z humor turns a late-night travel pain point in Japan into a sharp, shareable ride-hailing story.
description.zh: 用 Gen Z 幽默演绎日本年轻人的深夜出行痛点，突出便捷叫车体验。

title.zh: Cabify 日本深夜叫车广告

prompt.en: I’m looking to expand into the Japanese market and need an ad for a ride-hailing app that’s designed to perform well on X. Help me develop an eye-catching concept that feels native to how young people consume content, with a distinctly Gen Z sense of humor.
prompt.zh: 我要做日本市场的拓展，需要生成一条适合在X上传播的电商广告。你帮我构思适合打车软件的创意，要特别符合年轻人流媒体的喜好，有genz的幽默感，吸睛

title.zh: Cabify 日本深夜叫车广告

description.en: A pet-home review centered on fur and daily messes, showing the robot vacuum's practical household value.
description.zh: 从宠物毛发与日常清洁痛点切入，真实呈现扫地机器人的家庭使用价值。

title.en: CleanMate X8 Pro for Pet Homes
title.zh: CleanMate X8 Pro 养猫家庭种草

prompt.en: I want to create a product-seeding video for a robot vacuum, with a strong focus on why it’s a good fit for homes with pets. Tell me what information you need from me.
prompt.zh: 我要做个扫地机器人种草视频，重点要突出适合宠物家庭，告诉我你需要提供什么信息

title.zh: CleanMate X8 Pro 宠物家庭种草

description.en: A fake repair call becomes a playful twist: the capsule machine works fine—it simply needs to make more coffee.
description.zh: 用“误以为机器坏了”的反转短剧做钩子，自然带出胶囊咖啡机的使用乐趣。

prompt.en: Create a creative TikTok product-seeding video for my capsule coffee machine with a strong hook. You can build it around a short comedy skit—for example, pretending to repair the machine, only to discover that nothing is broken; it just needs to make more coffee.
prompt.zh: 给我的咖啡胶囊机做 TikTok 种草，有创意一点，带hook，可以添加一些剧情比如假装维修咖啡机最后发现咖啡机没有坏，只是需要做更多咖啡。

description.en: A high-energy KOC review combining authentic use with CGI effects to spotlight gaming control and performance.
description.zh: 将真实 KOC 体验与酷炫 CG 特效结合，集中展示游戏鼠标的操控与性能。

prompt.en: Create a 1-min KOC video target the US, with cool CGI effect
prompt.zh: 做1分钟带货视频，酷炫koc，带CG特效

description.en: A tender summer romance unfolds through a seaside town, 35mm texture, restrained credits, and a sunset encounter.
description.zh: 以海边小城、35mm 胶片与克制字幕，铺陈一段温柔的夏日爱情相遇。

prompt.en: Opening Title | 15-second, 2.39:1, 24fps live-action romance cast PV, SUMMER, WITH YOU. Original adult actors MIRA LIN and JULIAN PARK; a seaside town with a 35mm film look in cream white, ocean blue, and pale yellow. Four shots: a coastal train with no text; the female lead at a bookstore with “STARRING / MIRA LIN”; the male lead at the harbor with “JULIAN PARK”; and, after they meet at a street corner, the title is revealed on a sunset promenade. Serif typography, ample negative space, and occlusion transitions. No staged kissing, extra text, logos, or black screen.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒、2.39:1、24fps真人爱情卡司PV《SUMMER, WITH YOU》。原创成年演员MIRA LIN、JULIAN PARK，海边小城35mm胶片感，奶油白/海蓝/淡黄。四镜：海岸列车无字；书店女主配“STARRING/MIRA LIN”；港口男主配“JULIAN PARK”；街角相遇后夕阳步道揭示片名。文字衬线、留白充足、遮挡转场，不接吻摆拍、无额外文字/Logo/黑屏。

description.en: Friends cross highways, diners, and the coast in a bright 35mm road-trip opening about youthful freedom.
description.zh: 跟随好友驾车穿越公路、餐馆与海岸，以明亮胶片感定格青春旅程。

prompt.en: Opening Title | 15-second, 2.39:1, 24fps live-action coming-of-age road film, THE ROAD IS OURS. Original adult friends MAYA LIN, ELI PARK, and NOAH REED travel in a cream-white station wagon through sunrise highways, a vintage gas station, a diner, and a sunset coast; 35mm, bright and low-saturation. Their names are embedded in the gas-station canopy, road perspective, and wall in sequence; the title is revealed in the sunset reflection inside the car. Show only the specified cast names and title. No romance, brands, extra captions, logos, or black screen.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒、2.39:1、24fps真人青春公路片《THE ROAD IS OURS》。原创成年好友MAYA LIN、ELI PARK、NOAH REED，奶油白旅行车穿越日出公路、复古加油站、餐馆与夕阳海岸；35mm、明亮低饱和。姓名依次嵌入屋檐、公路透视和墙面，车内夕阳反射揭示片名。只出现指定卡司/片名，无爱情、品牌、额外字幕、Logo或黑屏。

description.en: An epic historical opening where monumental stone canals bring rushing water to an ancient desert canyon.
description.zh: 以古代峡谷、巨型石渠与奔涌清水，构建恢弘而写实的文明史诗片头。

prompt.en: Opening Title | 15-second, 2.39:1, 24fps historical epic, THE RIVER MAKERS. In an ancient, drought-stricken canyon, designer AMARA SOL and builder JONAS REED lead the people in activating a colossal stone aqueduct. 70mm film texture; sandstone gold, ochre, indigo, and verdigris; grand slow-motion shots. Their enormous, carved-looking names are embedded in arches and sandstone walls; after the sluice gate rises and clear water surges through, an aerial shot reveals the title. No war, magic, modern machinery, extra text, or logos.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒、2.39:1、24fps历史史诗《THE RIVER MAKERS》。古代干旱峡谷中，设计者AMARA SOL与建造者JONAS REED带领众人启用巨型石渠。70mm胶片质感，砂岩金/赭石/靛蓝/铜绿，宏大慢镜头。巨型雕刻感姓名嵌入拱门与砂岩墙；闸门升起、清水奔涌后航拍揭示片名。无战争、魔法、现代机械、额外文字或Logo。

description.en: A restrained 1960s aviation drama opening built around hangar checks, vintage aircraft, and a flight above the clouds.
description.zh: 以六十年代航空、机库检查与穿云起飞，呈现克制而辽阔的年代剧情片头。

prompt.en: Opening Title | 15-second, 2.39:1, 24fps 1960s aviation drama cast PV, THE OPEN SKY. Original pilots CLARA VALE, ELIAS ROWE, and MARCUS LIN fly a vintage twin-prop transport aircraft to deliver supplies. Large-format film look; sand, aged silver, gray-green, and leather brown; cool blue and golden early-morning light. Hangar inspection, engine, flight map, and takeoff reveal the names in sequence; after the aircraft breaks through the clouds, the title fades into the negative space of the sky. No modern equipment, disasters, logos, extra text, or flashy transitions.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒、2.39:1、24fps六十年代航空剧情卡司PV《THE OPEN SKY》。原创飞行员CLARA VALE、ELIAS ROWE、MARCUS LIN驾驶老式双螺旋桨运输机运送物资。大画幅胶片、沙土/旧银/灰绿/皮革棕、清晨冷蓝金光。机库检查、发动机、航图、起飞依次展示姓名，穿云后天空留白淡入片名。无现代设备、灾难、Logo、额外文字或炫技转场。

description.en: An inverted ocean and drifting whales transform a dry stone city into a serene magical-realist spectacle.
description.zh: 让倒悬海洋与鲸群掠过干旱石城，营造宁静震撼的魔幻现实主义奇观。

prompt.en: Opening Title | 15-second, 2.39:1, 24fps magical-realist epic opening, THE OCEAN ABOVE. An inverted ocean appears above an arid stone city, whales swim through it, and droplets from the city rise against gravity; the crowd watches in quiet awe, with no disaster panic. A 70mm live-action visual-effects look in limestone white, terracotta orange, and deep-sea blue, with realistic caustics. The giant words “OCEAN” and “ABOVE,” followed by the final title, are revealed through occlusion by architecture, flowing water, and whales. No extra text, neon, game-like CG, logos, or black screen.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒、2.39:1、24fps魔幻现实主义史诗片头《THE OCEAN ABOVE》。干旱石城上空出现倒置海洋，鲸群游弋，城市水滴逆重力升空；人群安静敬畏，无灾难恐慌。70mm实拍特效感，石灰白/陶土橙/深海蓝、真实焦散。巨型“OCEAN”“ABOVE”与终片名借建筑、水流、鲸鱼遮挡揭示。无额外文字、霓虹、游戏CG、Logo或黑屏。

description.en: 1970s posters, French New Wave imagery, and fashion collage create a crisp European art-film opening.
description.zh: 融合七十年代海报、法国新浪潮与时尚拼贴，形成复古而利落的艺术电影开场。

title.zh: 欧洲艺术电影拼贴片头

prompt.en: Opening Title | 15s 16:9 European art-film titles: 1970s posters, French New Wave, fashion collage. B&W city photos, beige paper, red/silver, grain; projector→magazine→poster freeze. Neo-jazz; no crime/fantasy.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒16:9欧洲艺术电影片头：1970年代海报、法国新浪潮与时尚拼贴。黑白城市照片、米色纸张、红色/银色和胶片颗粒；投影机→杂志→海报定格。Neo Jazz；无犯罪或奇幻元素。

title.zh: 欧洲艺术电影拼贴片头

description.en: An ensemble urban romance woven through global cities, dimensional credits, and polished editorial compositing.
description.zh: 以多城爱情群像、立体字幕与高级合成，编织成熟时尚的都市情感片头。

prompt.en: Opening Title | 15-second Western urban romance opening with top-tier AE title design. Across modern cities such as New York, Paris, and London, a multi-character romantic ensemble passes one another, talks over coffee, runs through the city, and appears in office and rooftop scenes. Live action is layered with dimensional typography, kinetic typography, geometric lines, HUD elements, particles, light sweeps, film burns, glass refraction, and multilayer compositing; names are embedded in buildings, glass, and street signs, and the fragments ultimately converge into the title and cast names. Warm film tones, fashionable and mature. Avoid saccharine romance, cheap templates, suspense, and horror.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒欧美都市爱情片头，顶级AE影视包装。纽约/巴黎/伦敦等现代城市中，以多人物爱情群像呈现擦肩、咖啡交谈、奔跑、办公室与天台片段。实拍叠加立体字幕、kinetic typography、几何线条、HUD、粒子、光扫、胶片燃烧、玻璃折射和多层合成；姓名嵌入建筑/玻璃/路牌，最终碎片汇聚成片名与卡司。暖色胶片、时尚成熟，避免甜宠、廉价模板、悬疑恐怖。

description.en: Cinematic sci-fi credits travel through future cities, stations, and labs with scanning, particles, and dimensional type.
description.zh: 穿梭未来城市、空间站与实验室，用扫描解码和粒子重组打造电影级科幻字幕。

prompt.en: Opening Title | 15-second Western sci-fi Opening Credits, seamlessly combining live-action futuristic cities, space stations, spacecraft, laboratories, and AI centers with premium AE title design. In a dark environment, particles, wireframes, mechanical scans, grids, data nodes, and holographic glass build up layer by layer; characters appear in dynamic windows, while names are revealed through scan decoding, 3D typography, masks, and particle/liquid-metal reconstruction, ultimately converging into the film logo and cast names. Hollywood-grade compositing, volumetric light, and depth of field. Avoid game UI, cheap HUDs, garbled text, and generic neon-tech styling.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒欧美科幻Opening Credits，真人未来城市、空间站、飞船、实验室与AI中心深度融合高级AE包装。黑暗空间中粒子、线框、机械扫描、网格、数据节点和全息玻璃逐层生成；人物以动态窗口出现，姓名经扫描解码、3D字体、遮罩、粒子/液态金属重组展示，最终汇聚电影Logo与卡司。好莱坞级合成、体积光与景深，避免游戏UI、廉价HUD、乱码和普通霓虹科技风。

description.en: Classrooms, clubs, sports, and prom unite a large campus ensemble through Polaroids, doodles, and torn-paper credits.
description.zh: 用课堂、社团、球场与舞会串联校园群像，以拍立得和涂鸦拼出青春卡司海报。

prompt.en: Opening Title | 15s teen-campus ensemble titles: 20+ students/teachers in classes, clubs, stadium/prom. Premium AE collage: kinetic names, Polaroids, doodles, paper tears; final cast poster. Bright, not dark/cheap.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒青少年校园群像片头：20名以上学生/教师出现在课堂、社团、体育场和舞会中。高级AE拼贴：动态姓名、拍立得、涂鸦和撕纸；最终形成卡司海报。整体明亮，不要阴暗或廉价质感。

description.en: A poetic opening of blue sunflowers, morning mist, old photographs, and restrained pixel-sorted typography.
description.zh: 在晨雾蓝色向日葵花海中，以旧照片、露珠与像素错位书写诗意片头。

title.en: WHERE THE BLUE SUNFLOWERS SLEEP Opening

prompt.en: Opening Title | A 15-second poetic-realist opening for WHERE THE BLUE SUNFLOWERS SLEEP: endless blue sunflowers, morning mist after rain, 35mm, 2.39:1, and low-saturation cyan-blue tones. Elise, wearing an off-white dress, walks through the flower field; dew, windblown petals, reflections on water, old photographs, and morning light carry the cast names and title in sequence. Apply only restrained Pixel Sorting to all text: 6–8 frames to assemble and 4–6 frames to disperse, keeping it legible and never damaging the character. Piano, cello, and wind sounds. No neon, heavy glitch, RGB separation, or full-screen pixelation.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜《WHERE THE BLUE SUNFLOWERS SLEEP》15秒诗意现实主义片头：无边蓝色向日葵、晨雾雨后、35mm、2.39:1、低饱和青蓝。Elise穿米白长裙穿过花海，露珠、风中花瓣、水面倒影、旧照片与晨光依次承载卡司及片名。所有文字仅做克制Pixel Sorting：6–8帧聚合、4–6帧消散，保持清晰，不伤人物；钢琴/大提琴/风声，禁霓虹、强glitch、RGB分离和全屏像素化。

title.en: WHERE THE BLUE SUNFLOWERS SLEEP Opening

description.en: A red wagon travels from a desert town to Pacific cliffs in a grounded road-drama opening built on hard cuts.
description.zh: 红色旅行车从沙漠小镇驶向太平洋悬崖，以硬切构成写实公路故事。

prompt.en: Opening Title | 15s 2.39:1 road drama, THE LAST MILE WEST. Claire and Evan drive a red wagon from desert town to Pacific cliff with “OPEN AT THE OCEAN.” Five hard cuts, exact text, consistent faces/car; no CGI.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒、2.39:1公路剧情片《THE LAST MILE WEST》。Claire与Evan驾驶红色旅行车，从沙漠小镇驶向太平洋悬崖，沿途带有“OPEN AT THE OCEAN”。五次硬切，文字必须准确，人物面孔与车辆保持一致；不要CGI。

description.en: A realistic investigator moves through a brass steam city shaped by newspaper collage, mechanical tracking, and film texture.
description.zh: 以黄铜蒸汽城、报纸拼贴与机械追踪，塑造写实调查员的复古工业片头。

prompt.en: Opening Title | A 15-second photorealistic steampunk cast sequence for THE BRASS VEIL: 35mm, 2.39:1, brass, coal black, oxidized green, and dark red; a European steam city, FUI tracking, simulated film glitches, and newspaper collage. Mechanical investigator Ada Vale moves through streets and stations while the clock tower, train, and pocket-watch UI lock on precisely; three character freeze-frames generate paper silhouettes, and gears converge into the final poster with the specified cast. Use brief glitches only at the beginning and end. No cyber neon, modern cities, drifting UI, garbled text, or cartoon faces.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜《THE BRASS VEIL》15秒写实蒸汽朋克卡司：35mm、2.39:1，黄铜/煤黑/氧化绿/暗红，欧洲蒸汽城、FUI追踪、模拟胶片故障与报纸拼贴。机械调查员Ada Vale穿行街道和车站，钟楼/列车/怀表UI精准锁定；三次人物定格生成纸质剪影，齿轮汇聚成最终海报及指定卡司。仅开头/结尾短故障，禁赛博霓虹、现代城市、UI漂移、乱码与卡通脸。

description.en: A red thread links two characters across rural Japan and Tokyo in a starry anime opening with punk-zine collage.
description.zh: 以跨越乡村与东京的红线连接双主角，用朋克杂志拼贴承载星夜思念。

prompt.en: Opening Title | 15s 2D anime collage: Shinkai-style emotion × punk magazines. A country girl and a Tokyo boy remain apart, linked by a red thread. Paper, xerox textures, and MAD-style cuts build 「星が降る夜、君を思い出す」 into a poster; no pastel fantasy.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒二维动漫拼贴：新海诚式情绪×朋克杂志。乡村女孩与东京男孩始终身处两地，由红线相连。纸张、复印质感和MAD式剪辑将「星が降る夜、君を思い出す」组成海报；不要粉彩奇幻风。

description.en: Maps and ancient books assemble a handcrafted magical academy, ending in a moonlit, candlelit fantasy poster.
description.zh: 从魔法地图与古书搭建手工学院模型，以月光、烛火和粒子完成奇幻定版。

prompt.en: Opening Title | A 15-second photorealistic miniature fantasy opening: a genuinely photographed handcrafted magic-academy model in deep antique bronze, parchment, gray stone, ink green, and warm gold, with cool moonlight separated from warm candlelight. Map particles build the castle → a magic book unfolds the academy → dark fragments awaken → the model reassembles into a THE WIZARDING LEGACY poster. Keep captions fixed, with characters used only for occlusion; use particles, pages, and smoke for hard cuts. No live-action people, animation, game UI, horror, explosions, or garbled text.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜15秒写实微缩奇幻片头：真实摄影的手工魔法学院模型，深古铜/羊皮纸/灰石/墨绿/暖金，月光与烛火冷暖分离。地图粒子建城堡→魔法书展开学院→黑暗碎片苏醒→模型重组为《THE WIZARDING LEGACY》海报。字幕固定、人物仅遮挡；用粒子/书页/烟雾硬切，禁真人、动画、游戏UI、恐怖、爆炸和乱码。

description.en: The reference image's antique-bronze look guides maps, spellbooks, and a miniature academy into a cinematic fantasy poster.
description.zh: 沿用参考图的古铜摄影质感，让地图、魔法书与微缩学院重组成奇幻海报。

prompt.en: Opening Title | Use Image 1 only as a reference for color tone and photographic texture. A 15-second photorealistic miniature fantasy opening: a genuinely photographed handcrafted magic-academy model in deep antique bronze, parchment, gray stone, ink green, and warm gold, with cool moonlight separated from warm candlelight. Map particles build the castle → a magic book unfolds the academy → dark fragments awaken → the model reassembles into a THE WIZARDING LEGACY poster. Keep captions fixed, with characters used only for occlusion. No live-action people, animation, game UI, horror, explosions, or garbled text.
prompt.zh: Opening Title｜@图片1为色调与摄影质感参考。15秒写实微缩奇幻片头：真实摄影的手工魔法学院模型，深古铜/羊皮纸/灰石/墨绿/暖金，月光与烛火冷暖分离。地图粒子建城堡→魔法书展开学院→黑暗碎片苏醒→模型重组为《THE WIZARDING LEGACY》海报。字幕固定、人物仅遮挡；禁真人、动画、游戏UI、恐怖、爆炸和乱码。

description.en: Maps, letters, Polaroids, and a red thread connect playful city encounters in a warm New Wave rom-com opening.
description.zh: 用地图、信封、拍立得与红线串联都市巧遇，呈现俏皮温暖的新浪潮爱情片头。

prompt.en: A 15-second 16:9 premium romantic-comedy Opening Title: French New Wave × 1960s–70s romance magazines × modern graphic animation. Cream white, cherry red, pale pink, retro yellow, and sky blue, with 35mm texture and paper collage; maps, envelopes, Polaroids, coffee, tickets, chat bubbles, and a red line connect urban chance encounters, time together, and chaos. Each of the six specified credits appears exactly once, ending on a vintage movie poster freeze-frame. Neo Jazz × Indie Pop; romantic, warm, and playful. No live-action plot scenes, cheap wedding/saccharine romance aesthetics, or cartoon styling.
prompt.zh: 15秒16:9高级浪漫喜剧Opening Title：法国新浪潮×60–70年代爱情杂志×现代平面动画。奶油白/樱桃红/浅粉/复古黄/天蓝，35mm与纸张拼贴；地图、信封、拍立得、咖啡、车票、聊天气泡和红线串联都市巧遇、相处与混乱，六组指定署名各出现一次，最终定格复古电影海报。Neo Jazz×Indie Pop，浪漫温暖俏皮，禁真人剧情、廉价婚礼/甜宠/卡通风。

description.en: NASA archives, engineering blueprints, and black-hole imagery create a restrained hard-science-fiction journey.
description.zh: 融合 NASA 档案、工程蓝图与黑洞影像，营造理性克制的硬科幻探索感。

prompt.en: Opening Title | A 15-second 16:9 hard-sci-fi opening inspired by the subject matter of Interstellar: 1970s NASA archive posters × Nolan-style realistic science fiction × engineering blueprints. Deep-space black, ice blue, and yellowed kraft paper; ample negative space, stardust particles, Saturn/black-hole photographs, wormhole line drawings, and typewritten credits. Gramophone → interstellar trajectory → gravity archive → Lazarus Project → five-dimensional spacetime → final poster. Every English credit appears exactly once. Organ, piano, strings, and vinyl noise; no visual clutter, soft-glow AI look, cartoon space, or copied soundtrack.

description.en: A white-haired, golden-eyed swordsman draws his blade through blue-black ink, cherry blossoms, and rhythmic calligraphy.
description.zh: 白发金瞳剑士踏风拔刀，以蓝黑水墨、樱花和书法卡点形成英雄定版。

prompt.en: Please focus on the white-haired, golden-eyed swordsman and long sword in the reference picture, and create a two-dimensional battle PV with blue and black ink, cherry blossom rice paper, and calligraphy stuck in the wind: showing sword drawing, wind walking, sword light, and cherry blossom bursts, adding ink masking, calligraphy movement, sword light sweeping, battle original painting slicing and reorganization, and AE push-pull following, and finally the final version of the ink hero is formed.
prompt.zh: 请锁定参考图中的白发金瞳剑士与长刀，制作蓝黑水墨、樱花宣纸与书法卡点风的二次元战斗PV：表现拔刀、踏风、刀光和樱花爆发，加入水墨遮罩、书法大字运动、剑光扫过、战斗原画切片重组和AE推拉跟随，最后形成水墨英雄定版。

description.en: Y2K pop, Swiss grids, and dense kinetic lyrics switch character details and looks to an electro-rap beat.
description.zh: 以 Y2K 波普、瑞士网格和高密度歌词，随电音节拍切换角色细节与造型。

prompt.en: Please inherit the character image in the reference picture and create a 15-second Japanese Electro Pop Rap two-dimensional character PV; use Y2K pop, Swiss grid, future UI and high-density dynamic lyrics, so that the character's eyes, headphones, clothing and full-body original paintings switch with the beat, add geometric masks, text splitting and reorganization, neon light sweeps and AE fast push and pull, and finally finalize it into a complete character poster.
prompt.zh: 请继承参考图中的人物形象，制作15秒Japanese Electro Pop Rap二次元角色PV；采用Y2K波普、瑞士网格、未来UI与高密度动态歌词，让人物眼睛、耳机、服装和全身原画随节拍切换，加入几何遮罩、文字拆分重组、霓虹光扫过及AE快速推拉，最终定格为完整角色海报。

description.en: Cel artwork, Polaroids, and film perforations combine with restrained camera moves for a fresh editorial character piece.
description.zh: 融合赛璐璐立绘、拍立得与胶片孔，用克制推拉呈现清新文艺的杂志角色版式。

prompt.en: Please follow the characters and layout directions in the reference picture and create a Japanese Editorial two-dimensional character PV of about 12 seconds; combine cel drawings, film holes, polaroids, rounded frames, checkerboards and elegant serif text, and use photo flipping masks, text movement along the frame, flash sweeps, partial slicing and reorganization of characters and AE restrained push-pull to form a fresh and artistic magazine-style layout.
prompt.zh: 请继承参考图中的人物与版式方向，制作约12秒Japanese Editorial二次元角色PV；融合赛璐璐立绘、胶片孔、拍立得、圆角画框、棋盘格与优雅衬线字，以照片翻转遮罩、文字沿框运动、闪光扫过、人物局部切片重组和AE克制推拉形成清新文艺的杂志式定版。

description.en: Sweet-edgy idol staging, shoujo panels, and kinetic lyrics capture MIKA's gestures, styling, and musical energy.
description.zh: 以甜酷偶像舞台、少女漫画分格和动态歌词，捕捉 MIKA 的手势与节拍魅力。

title.zh: MIKA KUROSE 偶像 PV I

prompt.en: Create a 15-second sweet and cool idol two-dimensional music PV for MIKA KUROSE; use Kawaii J-Pop, girl comic grids, sweet magazine collage and dynamic lyrics to express eyes, gestures, clothing, headphones and stage movements, add love masks, lyrics word splitting movement, chasing light sweep, character original painting slicing and reorganization and AE push and pull, and finally freeze it into an idol promotional poster.
prompt.zh: 为MIKA KUROSE制作15秒甜酷偶像二次元音乐PV；采用Kawaii J-Pop、少女漫画分格、甜系杂志拼贴与动态歌词，表现眼睛、手势、服装、耳机和舞台动作，加入爱心遮罩、歌词拆字运动、追光扫过、角色原画切片重组及AE推拉，最后定格为偶像宣传海报。

title.zh: MIKA KUROSE 偶像 PV I

description.en: Heart masks, spotlights, and deconstructed lyrics amplify MIKA's sweet-edgy performance and idol-poster finale.
description.zh: 用爱心遮罩、追光与歌词拆字强化 MIKA 的甜酷舞台表现和偶像海报定版。

title.zh: MIKA KUROSE 偶像 PV II

prompt.en: Create a 15-second sweet and cool idol two-dimensional music PV for MIKA KUROSE; use Kawaii J-Pop, girl comic grids, sweet magazine collage and dynamic lyrics to express eyes, gestures, clothing, headphones and stage movements, add love masks, lyrics word splitting movement, chasing light sweep, character original painting slicing and reorganization and AE push and pull, and finally freeze it into an idol promotional poster.
prompt.zh: 为MIKA KUROSE制作15秒甜酷偶像二次元音乐PV；采用Kawaii J-Pop、少女漫画分格、甜系杂志拼贴与动态歌词，表现眼睛、手势、服装、耳机和舞台动作，加入爱心遮罩、歌词拆字运动、追光扫过、角色原画切片重组及AE推拉，最后定格为偶像宣传海报。

title.zh: MIKA KUROSE 偶像 PV II

description.en: Four consistent band members, instruments, and positions come alive through cel-shaded performance and spatial lyrics.
description.zh: 保持四名成员、乐器和站位稳定，以三渲二演奏和空间歌词完成乐队海报。

title.zh: 四人 J-Pop 乐队 PV

prompt.en: Create a 15-second three-rendered two-part J-Pop band MV for the four fixed members, keeping the appearance, clothing, instruments, and positions of the lead singer, bassist, drummer, and keyboardist consistent; combined with stage performance, lyrics space layout, and member interaction, adding instrument masking, text movement, stage tracking, character slice reorganization, and AE push-pull surround, and finally formed a complete band poster.
prompt.zh: 为四名固定成员制作15秒三渲二J-Pop乐队MV，保持主唱、贝斯手、鼓手、键盘手的外貌、服装、乐器与站位一致；结合舞台演奏、歌词空间排版和成员互动，加入乐器擦镜遮罩、文字运动、舞台追光扫过、人物切片重组及AE推拉环绕，最后形成完整乐队海报。

title.zh: 四人 J-Pop 乐队 PV

description.en: Cel portraits, chibi icons, and pixel UI introduce four characters before resolving into a bright romantic-comedy logo.
description.zh: 用赛璐璐立绘、Q 版头像和像素 UI 快切介绍四位角色，收束成轻快恋爱喜剧 Logo。

prompt.en: Create a 15-second horizontal version of the Galgame love comedy PV for the four fixed characters of HINA, REI, YORU, and MIU; using cel vertical painting, Q-version avatars, pixel UI, and Japanese MG typesetting, character introductions, window fast cuts, prop vortexes, and logo wrapping were completed in sequence, and ring masks, name splitting movements, starburst sweeps, original painting slices and reorganization, and AE push-pull were added to finalize the version of "HEART//LINK".
prompt.zh: 为HINA、REI、YORU、MIU四名固定角色制作15秒横版Galgame恋爱喜剧PV；采用赛璐璐立绘、Q版头像、像素UI和日系MG排版，依次完成角色介绍、窗口快切、道具漩涡与Logo收束，加入圆环遮罩、名字拆字运动、星芒扫过、原画切片重组和AE推拉，最终定版“HEART//LINK”。

description.en: Footsteps, clocks, moon phases, and a wine glass drive a cold-blue urban duel between a swordswoman and her rival.
description.zh: 以脚步、时钟、月相和酒杯推进女刀客与灰发反派的冷蓝都市对决。

prompt.en: Create a 15-second cold blue JRPG PV for my original female swordsman with short black hair in uniform and a gray-haired villain with a wide hat; use footsteps, clocks, moon phases and wine glasses to advance the urban fantasy plot, add silhouette inversion masking, minimalist text movement, blue light sweeping, original painting slicing and reorganization of characters and props, and AE push-pull, and finally use clock scales to spell out the original game title and "FACE THE NIGHT".
prompt.zh: 为我原创的黑短发制服女刀客与宽帽灰发反派制作15秒冷蓝JRPG PV；以脚步、时钟、月相和酒杯推进都市奇幻剧情，加入剪影反相遮罩、极简文字运动、青蓝光扫过、人物与道具原画切片重组及AE推拉，最后由时钟刻度拼成原创游戏标题与“FACE THE NIGHT”。

description.en: A midnight train, butterflies, spirit forms, and an eclipse shape the mysterious opening of a death-themed JRPG.
description.zh: 用午夜列车、蝴蝶、精神体与月食，构建冷蓝死亡主题 JRPG 的悬疑序章。

prompt.en: Create about 20 seconds of cold blue PV for an original black-haired high school student and his teammates in a midnight death-themed JRPG; show shoes, silhouettes, butterflies, mental bodies, trains and lunar eclipses, use clock scales and scan lines, add oblique color block masks, English UI text movement, blue and white inverse sweeps, original character painting slices and reorganization, and AE push-pull low-camera tracking. Finally, use a broken clock to spell out "BLUE HOUR / FACE THE NIGHT".
prompt.zh: 请为原创黑发高中生与队友在午夜死亡主题JRPG中制作约20秒冷蓝PV；表现鞋子、剪影、蝴蝶、精神体、列车与月食，使用时钟刻度与扫描线，加入斜切色块遮罩、英文UI文字运动、蓝白反相扫过、人物原画切片重组及AE推拉低机位跟拍，最后由碎裂时钟拼出“BLUE HOUR / FACE THE NIGHT”。

description.en: A girl in a golden sunflower field becomes a bright anime poster through film frames, kinetic lyrics, and warm rim light.
description.zh: 少女置身蓝天与暖黄花海，以胶片孔、动态歌词和侧逆光组成明朗角色海报。

prompt.en: Please generate a 12-second PV of the beautiful girl character in the Japanese anime Sunflower Flower Sea. The whole process is original without reference pictures: the blue sky, the warm yellow flower sea, the girl in cream white dress, dark green skirt and sunflower hair accessories are throughout the film. Add film hole mask, dynamic lyrics movement, warm side backlight sweep, character and photo original painting slice reorganization and AE restrained push and pull, and finally synthesize a complete sunflower poster.
prompt.zh: 请生成12秒日系动漫向日葵花海美少女角色PV，全程无参考图原创：蓝天、暖黄花海、奶油白衣深绿裙与向日葵发饰的少女贯穿全片，加入胶片孔遮罩、动态歌词运动、温暖侧逆光扫过、人物与照片原画切片重组及AE克制推拉，最终合成一张完整向日葵海报。

description.en: Classrooms, rooftops, train stations, and seaside slopes connect two heroines through intimate youth memories.
description.zh: 以教室、天台、电车站和海边坡道串联双女主的日常片段与青春念白。

title.zh: 《青にほどける》青春动画 PV

prompt.en: Create a 15-second Japanese youth animation PV "Ao Kokoro" for the original two heroines Asakura Asakura and Mizunase Koko; use sunset classrooms, rooftops, tram stops and seaside ramps to connect life The clips and Japanese narration were added with sunlight overexposure masks, Japanese serif text movements, warm side backlight sweeps, reorganization of the two people's original painting slices and slow AE push-pull, and ended with a watercolor blue halo to finalize the title.
prompt.zh: 请为原创双女主朝仓ひより与水瀬しずく制作15秒日系青春动画PV《青にほどける》；以夕阳教室、天台、电车站和海边坡道串联生活片段与日语念白，加入阳光过曝遮罩、日文衬线文字运动、暖光侧逆光扫过、两人原画切片重组及AE慢速推拉，结尾以水彩蓝晕定版片名。

title.zh: 《青にほどける》青春动画 PV

description.en: Black futurist architecture, red warning light, and transparent HUD layers create a cinematic game-entry sequence.
description.zh: 以黑色未来主义都市、红色警示光与透明 HUD，营造电影级游戏初始进入体验。

prompt.en: Use MiniMax H3 to sequentially generate two continuous 15-second clips for a 16:9 anime-style sci-fi game PV. Analyze Images 1–7: use Image 4 to lock the character’s identity, and bind the remaining images to the environments, UI, composition, and visual style according to the original instructions. In the first clip, show the elevator opening, identity scan, and START interaction. In the second, show the rooftop run, vault and landing, followed by the reveal of the MINIMAX tower. Maintain consistent character identity, clothing, lighting, camera movement, voice-over, and sound throughout.
prompt.zh: 请用MiniMax H3依次生成两个15秒连续片段。制作16:9二次元科幻游戏PV，分析图1-7：图4锁定角色，其余按原提示绑定场景、界面、构图与风格。第一段呈现电梯开启、身份扫描及START交互；第二段呈现天台奔跑、翻越落地和MINIMAX大厦揭示。统一人物、服装、光色、运镜、旁白与音效。

description.en: A reference-locked cyber character moves through a saturated loadout space with clear menu and equipment interactions.
description.zh: 锁定赛博角色与装备参考，通过高饱和空间和菜单交互完成角色装载展示。

prompt.en: Use MiniMax H3 to create a 15-second, 16:9 anime-style cyberpunk game character PV. Use the input image to lock the character’s identity, face, outfit, and prosthetic limbs, while extracting references for the UI, color palette, and visual style. Follow the original storyboard to show menu interaction, arm reconfiguration, configuration confirmation, environment loading, and third-person city entry. Maintain continuity across the character, equipment, UI text, actions, camera work, and sound. Confirm the complete storyboard and final prompt before generating and reviewing the full video.
prompt.zh: 请用MiniMax H3制作一条15秒、16:9二次元赛博游戏角色PV。以输入图锁定角色身份、脸部、服装与义肢，并提取UI、色彩和画风参考。按原分镜呈现菜单点击、双臂装备重构、配置确认、环境加载及第三人称入城；确保人物、装备、界面文字、动作因果、镜头与声音连续。先确认完整分镜和最终提示词，再整条生成并质检。

description.en: Rin crosses ruined landscapes with a red scarf and cassette player in a 2D glitch-collage apocalypse.
description.zh: 少女凛携红围巾与磁带机穿越废墟，以二维故障拼贴凝成末日海报。

prompt.en: Create a 15-second purely 2D apocalyptic glitch-collage game PV. An original girl, Rin, wearing an old uniform, red scarf, and cassette player crosses ruins. Structure it with glitch boot-up, freeze-frame character collage, wasteland open world, collage burst, and final poster; add scanline masks, Japanese text motion, fluorescent cyan sweeps, sliced recombination of character and ruin artwork, and horizontal AE tracking push/pulls, ending on 《終末残響》.
prompt.zh: 请生成15秒纯二维末日故障拼贴游戏PV，原创少女“凛”穿旧制服、红围巾与磁带播放器穿越废墟；以故障开机、人物定格拼贴、废土开放世界、Collage爆发和最终海报组成结构，加入扫描线遮罩、日文文字运动、荧光青光扫过、角色与废墟原画切片重组及AE横向Tracking推拉，最终定版《終末残響》。

description.en: A failed system boot expands from comic panels into a 3A post-apocalyptic city through red scans and controlled glitches.
description.zh: 从系统启动失败切入漫画格与 3A 城市场景，以红色扫描和故障层层揭开末日世界。

prompt.en: Create a 15-second FUI glitch-art apocalyptic game PV for AFTER//EDEN. Follow a storyline of failed system boot, realistic comic panels, red scanlines transforming into real AAA game CG, a futuristic city, a city of flowers, cyber forests, and a title-card close. Add data-crack masks, FUI text motion, red scanning-light sweeps, sliced recombination of comic/CG artwork, and 3D AE layer push/pull parallax, ending with “AFTER//EDEN / RECLAIM THE LOST WORLD”.
prompt.zh: 请制作《AFTER//EDEN》15秒FUI故障艺术末日游戏PV：以系统启动失败、写实漫画格展开、红色扫描线转真实3A游戏CG、未来城市、城市花海、赛博山林和标题卡收束为主线；加入数据裂缝遮罩、FUI文字运动、红色扫描光扫过、漫画/CG原画切片重组及AE三维图层推拉视差，最终出现“AFTER//EDEN / RECLAIM THE LOST WORLD”。

description.en: A smoke-gray perfume bottle becomes the sole hero as fragrance reshapes light, glass, and abstract architecture.
description.zh: 让烟灰玻璃香水瓶在抽象建筑光影中成为唯一主角，完成奢华 Hero 定版。

prompt.en: Create a short advertisement for a high-end perfume within 15 seconds, with the AURELIS NO.01 ash glass bottle as the sole protagonist. Keep the logo, bottle shape and amber liquid stable, use luxury perfume and abstract architectural space style to express the fragrance, reshape light, glass and space, and finally complete the final version of Hero.
prompt.zh: 做一支15秒以内高端香水短广告，AURELIS NO.01烟灰玻璃瓶为唯一主角，保持Logo、瓶型和琥珀液体稳定，用奢侈香水与抽象建筑空间风格表现香气重塑光线、玻璃和空间，最后完成Hero定版。

description.en: Macro hardware details open into multiple game worlds before streams of light return to the original handheld.
description.zh: 从掌机硬件微距穿入多重游戏世界，再以光流回收突出原创产品设计。

prompt.en: Make a 15-second short advertisement for a game handheld console, with the original MiniMax Console as the protagonist, keeping the screen, buttons and handle structure stable, without copying the existing console, using Apple-level hardware advertising and game trailer style to enter multiple game worlds from the product macro, and finally the optical flow is recycled and finalized.
prompt.zh: 做一支15秒的游戏掌机短广告，原创MiniMax Console为主角，保持屏幕、按键和手柄结构稳定，不复制现有主机，用Apple级硬件广告和游戏Trailer风格从产品微距进入多重游戏世界，最后光流回收定版。

description.en: Transparent glass technology and future lifestyle scenes show AI glasses understanding the world before a floating hero shot.
description.zh: 以透明玻璃科技和未来生活场景，表现 AI 眼镜理解环境并悬浮定版。

prompt.en: Make a short advertisement for AI smart glasses within 15 seconds, with original MiniMax Glasses as the protagonist, keeping the frame, lens, camera and logo stable, without copying existing smart glasses, using future lifestyle and transparent glass technology style to express the glasses’ understanding of the world and finally suspending the final version.
prompt.zh: 做一支15秒以内AI智能眼镜短广告，原创MiniMax Glasses为主角，保持镜框、镜片、摄像头和Logo稳定，不复制现有智能眼镜，用未来生活方式与透明玻璃科技风格表现眼镜理解世界并最终悬浮定版。

description.en: A serum drop repairs a dry surface through translucent water membranes and luxurious skincare textures.
description.zh: 以精华滴落修护干燥表面，借透明水膜与奢侈材质呈现焕新力量。

prompt.en: Make a short advertisement of high-end skin care essence within 15 seconds, with the ELYSIAN LAB RENEWAL SERUM dropper bottle as the protagonist, keeping the bottle shape, logo and liquid highly stable, using the style of luxury skin care and transparent water film materials to show the essence dripping to repair the dry surface, and finally finalizing the product. This is not an ordinary beauty e-commerce advertisement, a laboratory product description film, or a simple glass bottle rotating display, but an international high-end skin care brand concept film that combines luxury skin care product photography, abstract material art, microscopic moisture structure, Cinema 4D fluid animation, After Effects advanced motion graphics and fashion cinematography.
prompt.zh: 做一支15秒以内高端护肤精华短广告，ELYSIAN LAB RENEWAL SERUM滴管瓶为主角，保持瓶型、Logo和液体高度稳定，用奢侈护肤与透明水膜材质风格表现精华滴落修护干燥表面，最后产品定版。这不是普通美妆电商广告，不是实验室产品说明片，也不是简单的玻璃瓶旋转展示，而是一支融合奢侈护肤品摄影、抽象材质艺术、微观水分结构、Cinema 4D流体动画、After Effects高级动态图形与时尚电影摄影的国际高端护肤品牌概念片。

description.en: Each modular brick connection triggers space-themed motion design before assembling a complete exploration base.
description.zh: 模块化积木每次拼搭都触发太空动效，最终组装成完整探索基地。

prompt.en: Make a short advertisement for space building blocks within 15 seconds, with ORBIT BRICKS modular building blocks as the protagonist, keeping the number of parts, structure and brand stable, without copying the existing building block brand, using high-density motion design and space exploration style to show that each build triggers AE-level special effects and completes the base version.
prompt.zh: 做一支15秒以内太空积木短广告，ORBIT BRICKS模块化积木为主角，保持零件数量、结构和品牌稳定，不复制现有积木品牌，用高密度Motion Design和太空探索风格表现每次拼搭触发AE级特效并完成基地定版。

description.en: Soft lavender luxury lighting reveals the pearl finish, twin star-trail rings, and camera details in a launch-ready spot.
description.zh: 用浅紫轻奢光影展示珍珠后盖、双环星轨与摄像头细节，完成发布会定版。

title.zh: 珍珠白星轨手机短广告

prompt.en: Make a short mobile phone advertisement within 15 seconds, with the pearl white star track mobile phone as the protagonist, keep the double ring star track back cover, dual camera module, body proportions and selling point text stable, use light purple light luxury consumer electronics style to display the glass star track, pearlescent back cover and camera details, and finally form the final version of the press conference.
prompt.zh: 做一支15秒以内手机短广告，珍珠白星轨手机为主角，保持双环星轨后盖、双摄模组、机身比例和卖点文字稳定，用浅紫轻奢消费电子风格展示玻璃星轨、珠光后盖和摄像头细节，最后形成发布会定版。

title.zh: 珍珠白星轨手机短广告

description.en: Teal rim light, exploded structures, and twisting bands reveal the smartwatch's precision and color range.
description.zh: 以青绿轮廓光、爆炸结构与表带扭转，展现智能手表的精密设计和系列配色。

prompt.en: Make a 15-second short advertisement for a smart watch. The black square watch is the protagonist. Keep the porous strap, LED sensor, crown and series colors stable. Use dark technology and turquoise outline light style to show the explosion, charging, strap twisting and multi-color array finalization.
