prompt.en: When making UI animation, strictly lock @Picture 1 sea salt potato chip packaging and the original text such as "thin crisp, potato chips, refreshing sea salt flavor, Sea Salt Flavor, 0 trans fatty acids, 50g". Following the TVC animation structure of @Video1, the hot and sour elements are changed to sea water, salt crystals and crispy potato chips: the packaging is suspended and rotated, the water and salt vortex shuttles, the potato chips explode, the kaleidoscope converges, and the salt rock hero freezes on the water; no one, no new subtitles, with strong rhythm electronic music and crisp sounds.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，严格锁定@图片1海盐薯片包装及“薄脆、马铃薯片、清爽海盐味、Sea Salt Flavor、0反式脂肪酸、50g”等原有文字。沿用@视频1的TVC动效结构，将酸辣元素改为海水、盐晶与薄脆薯片：包装悬浮旋转、水盐漩涡穿梭、薯片爆发、万花筒收束、水面盐岩英雄定格；无人、无新增字幕，配强节奏电子乐与脆响。

title.zh: 海盐薯片包装 UI 动效

description.en: Clean interface actions and key outcomes turn a 15-second website hero into a focused product-value demonstration.
description.zh: 以简洁界面操作和关键结果构建官网首屏，让产品价值在 15 秒内清晰落地。

title.zh: 官网首屏产品功能演示

prompt.en: Create a 15-second, 16:9 short product feature video on the first screen of the official website. The style is concise, technological, and has plenty of white space; no characters are required to speak, and it focuses on interface operations, key results, and lightweight ambient sounds.
prompt.zh: 帮我制作一条 15 秒、16:9 的官网首屏产品功能短片。 风格简洁、科技感、留白充足；不需要人物口播，以界面操作、关键结果和轻量环境音为主。

title.zh: 官网首屏产品功能演示

description.en: Explosive oversized type, speed lighting, and fluid scrolling build an energetic footwear landing-page experience.
description.zh: 以爆发式巨字、速度光影和流畅滚动，围绕鞋履产品打造动感官网落地页。

prompt.en: Generated with minimax h3, 15 seconds, 16:9. A website page, website page UI design, website animation, and video showing the smooth scrolling down effect of the web page. A very explosive and dynamic Nike official website style product landing page UI/UX demonstration video, the core display subject is the product picture 1. The page uses bold, powerful, slanted oversized sans serif fonts for bold layout. The background has a sense of speed, dynamic light and shadow, dark carbon fiber or sports breathable mesh textures that are intertwined and transformed. The video shows the fast-paced and powerful scrolling down effect of the web page, as well as UI interactive actions such as strong visual amplification and color inversion when the mouse is hovered.
prompt.zh: 用minimax h3生成，15 秒，16:9。一个网站页面，网站页面UI设计，网站动效，视频展示了流畅的网页向下滚动效果。一个极具爆发力与动感的耐克（Nike）官网风格产品落地页 UI/UX 演示视频，核心展示主体是该产品图片1。页面采用粗犷有力、倾斜的超大号无衬线字体进行张扬的排版。背景有极具速度感的动态光影、暗色碳纤维或运动透气网眼纹理在交织变换。视频展示了节奏紧凑、充满力量感的网页向下滚动效果，以及鼠标悬停时强烈的视觉放大与颜色反转等 UI 交互动作。

description.en: Liquid-metal and glass letters explode, flip, glitch, and reassemble into a high-energy neon brand title.
description.zh: 让液态金属与玻璃字母爆裂、翻转并故障重组，塑造高能霓虹品牌标题。

title.zh: MiniMax H3 霓虹 CG 标题片

prompt.en: Generate via Minimax H3, 15s, 16:9. Strictly follow: A hyper-stylized CG 3D neon title sequence for “MiniMaxH3” in a black void. Glossy liquid-metal/glass letters explode, flip, morph, glitch, shatter and rearrange with RGB split, pixel sorting, chromatic aberration, ray-traced reflections and volumetric neon light. A futuristic streetwear character moves through the typography: punching spinning numbers, surfing letter streams, throwing a giant “M” at camera, spin-kicking digits into colorful particle bursts. Letters collide with the body and wrap around limbs. Final 3s: all text orbits the character, then collapses into a clean glowing 3D title lock-up: “MiniMaxH3”, with small tagline “Beyond the Code”. Cinematic orbits, whip-pans, depth of field, fully CG 3D, no flat 2D.
prompt.zh: 通过 Minimax H3、15 秒、16:9 生成。严格遵循： 黑色空间中的“MiniMaxH3”超风格化 CG 3D 霓虹灯标题序列。有光泽的液态金属/玻璃字母会爆炸、翻转、变形、故障、破碎，并通过 RGB 分割、像素排序、色差、光线追踪反射和体积霓虹灯重新排列。 未来派街头服饰角色在版式中移动：敲打旋转的数字、冲浪字母流、向镜头扔出一个巨大的“M”、将旋转的数字踢成彩色的粒子爆发。字母与身体碰撞，缠绕在四肢上。 最后 3 秒：所有文本围绕角色旋转，然后折叠成一个干净发光的 3D 标题锁定：“MiniMaxH3”，带有小标语“Beyond the Code”。电影轨道、快速平移、景深、完全 CG 3D，无平面 2D。

title.zh: MiniMax H3 霓虹 CG 标题片

description.en: C++ code, CRT ghosts, film grain, and VHS color separation connect the reference images in a high-speed montage.
description.zh: 以 C++ 代码、CRT 虚影、胶片颗粒和 VHS 色差串联高速参考画面蒙太奇。

title.zh: 代码与 CRT 蒙太奇

prompt.en: Generated with minimax h3, 15 seconds, 16:9. The following prompts must be followed and modifications are not allowed: High-sensitivity dynamic images, a small amount of dilution, CRT picture tube images and C++ code elements appear faintly like ghosts. Scroll up and down, smooth transitions in the order of picture 1, picture 2, picture 3, picture 4, and picture 5. The whole film is uniformly superimposed with natural and dense film grains; increase the level of subtle shaking VHS Scan lines; when the lens moves at high speed, the chromatic aberration distortion of blue and red color separation is strengthened; digital screen tearing and color block distortion are randomly added to transition pictures.
prompt.zh: 用minimax h3生成，15 秒，16:9。必须遵循以下提示词，不允许改动：高感光度动态影像，少量淡化 CRT 显像管图像和C++ 代码元素如虚影般淡淡地浮现上下滚动，按图片1、图片2、图片3、图片4、图片5的顺序流畅衔接转场，全片统一叠加自然浓密的胶片颗粒；增加细微晃动的水平 VHS 扫描线；镜头高速运动时，强化蓝红色彩分离的色差畸变；转场画面随机添加数字画面撕裂、色块失真。

title.zh: 代码与 CRT 蒙太奇

description.en: Voice, percussion, ambience, and bass become draggable nodes, spheres, and waves in an immersive spatial-audio workflow.
description.zh: 把声音化为可拖拽节点、球体与波形，在空间重排中呈现沉浸式音频创作。

title.zh: 空间音频工具 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation, original spatial audio tool ECHO FIELD, retain "SOUND BECOMES SPACE." Turn vocals, percussion, ambient sounds and low frequencies into grabbable and draggable nodes, spheres, ribbons and waveforms: move the vocal position, widen the sound field, adjust the reverb, expand the time track and rearrange the rhythm, and finally switch to IMMERSIVE and enter sound sculpture. Dark gray frosted glass and soft volumetric light ban Bento, mixer, neon HUD and jumping numbers.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，原创空间音频工具ECHO FIELD，保留“SOUND BECOMES SPACE.”。把人声、打击乐、环境声和低频化为可抓取拖拽的节点、球体、织带与波形：移动人声位置、拉宽声场、调节混响、展开时间轨道并重排节奏，最后切换IMMERSIVE并进入声音雕塑。深灰磨砂玻璃与柔和体积光，禁Bento、调音台、霓虹HUD和跳动数字。

title.zh: 空间音频工具 UI 动效

description.en: Object-anchored panels, material tools, and portable collections merge with a real museum to demonstrate spatial interaction.
description.zh: 让展品锚定弹窗、材质工具与收藏窗口融入真实美术馆，展示空间计算交互。

title.zh: 艺术馆空间 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation and present "REALITY BECOMES A WORKSPACE." in a real contemporary art museum. Visitors evoke the multi-layered pop-up window that anchors the exhibit, expand the details and split images, materials and color tools; drag the color chip to change the lighting of the sculpture, play sound, merge two works for comparison, follow the collection window, and then transfer the content to the real installation in the next exhibition hall. Dark translucent space material, accurate occlusion and depth of field, only designated English operation words are retained, and numbers and sci-fi empty cabins are prohibited.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，以真实当代艺术馆呈现“REALITY BECOMES A WORKSPACE.”。参观者唤起锚定展品的多层弹窗，展开详情并拆分图片、材质和颜色工具；拖拽色片改变雕塑灯光，播放声音，合并两件作品比较，收藏窗口随身跟随，再把内容传入下一展厅的真实装置。深色半透明空间材质、准确遮挡与景深，仅保留指定英文操作词，禁数字和科幻空舱。

title.zh: 艺术馆空间 UI 动效

description.en: An editorial travel canvas lets users drag routes, save places, and rearrange photos into a composed Lisbon journey.
description.zh: 在编辑式旅行画布中拖拽路线、收藏地点并重排照片，流畅完成里斯本行程。

title.zh: 旅行策划应用 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation, travel planning application VELA, keep "JOURNEYS, COMPOSED." An editable travel canvas carries maps, routes, photos and text: explore LISBON, drag RIVER WALK to update routes, expand location details and collect them, rearrange photos on JOURNEY BOARD, switch OCEAN, TERRACOTTA, OLIVE themes, and finally fold back to VELA. Warm stone white paper feel, desaturated photos and shared transitions, banned Bento, imitation Apple interface and jumping numbers.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，旅行策划应用VELA，保留“JOURNEYS, COMPOSED.”。以编辑式旅行画布承载地图、路线、照片与文字：探索LISBON，拖拽RIVER WALK更新路线，展开地点详情并收藏，在JOURNEY BOARD重排照片，切换OCEAN、TERRACOTTA、OLIVE主题，最终折叠回VELA。暖石白纸感、低饱和照片和共享转场，禁Bento、仿Apple界面及跳动数字。

title.zh: 旅行策划应用 UI 动效

description.en: Spatial cards anchor to a rainy-night store's coffee machine, shelves, and counter from selection through pickup.
description.zh: 雨夜便利店中的空间卡片精准锚定咖啡机、货架与柜台，串联选购到取餐流程。

title.zh: 便利店空间 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make a UI animation to realistically describe a young man who has just gotten off work in a convenience store on a rainy night, choosing coffee and snacks, paying and sitting by the window. The space pop-up window unfolds from the rain-wet glass door, anchoring the coffee machine, shelves and counters; the COFFEE card is dragged to the coffee machine, BOLD is merged with MILK, SNACK is added to the order, PAY is attached to the counter, READY absorbs the paper bag and follows people to the window. Cold blue rainy night with warm amber store light, frosted acrylic and real occlusion reflection, only the designated English language is retained, without brand logo and numbers.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，写实雨夜便利店里，刚下班的年轻人选咖啡与零食、付款并坐到窗边。空间弹窗从雨湿玻璃门展开，锚定咖啡机、货架和柜台；COFFEE卡被拖到咖啡机，BOLD与MILK合并，SNACK加入订单，PAY贴合柜台，READY吸附纸袋并随人物到窗边。冷蓝雨夜与暖琥珀店光、磨砂亚克力和真实遮挡反射，仅保留指定英文，无品牌Logo和数字。

title.zh: 便利店空间 UI 动效

description.en: A first-person 3D armory guides users through inspecting, upgrading, and purchasing a legendary weapon.
description.zh: 第一人称浏览 3D 武器库，依次完成查看、升级与购买传奇装备的清晰交互。

title.zh: 未来游戏商店 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animations and enter the original future game store in first person. Click on WEAPONS to expand the 3D weapon library, hover to view the rotation, attributes and rarity, select the legendary weapon and drag it to check the details, then click UPGRADE to install the module, click BUY NOW and display PURCHASE COMPLETE. It adopts dark glass, neon and high-end cyber game mall textures, with clear interaction sequence, and retains designated English status such as STORE and LEGENDARY ITEM.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，第一人称进入原创未来游戏商店。鼠标点击WEAPONS展开3D武器库，悬停查看旋转、属性与稀有度，选中传奇武器后拖拽检查细节，再点击UPGRADE安装模块、点击BUY NOW并显示PURCHASE COMPLETE。采用暗玻璃、霓虹与高级赛博游戏商城质感，交互顺序清晰，保留STORE、LEGENDARY ITEM等指定英文状态。

title.zh: 未来游戏商店 UI 动效

description.en: Clear hover-and-click feedback customizes a frontier survivor's build, face, hair, and heavy outerwear.
description.zh: 以明确的悬停与点击反馈完成边境角色体型、面容、发型和服装定制。

title.zh: 荒野生存角色创建 UI

prompt.en: UI animation, brand RUSTLAND wilderness survival character creation. In the interface of a real 3D border character and a rusty black and orange industrial typewriter, the mouse selects the weathered female preset, female body shape, drags the chin, selects long dark brown curly hair, puts on a heavy windbreaker and confirms; only perform a clear hover→click→result for each paragraph, and connection points and automatic carousel are prohibited. The physics of skin, hair, leather and cloth are highlighted, and the ending changes to a golden sunset shot of the character hero and the RUSTLAND logo.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，品牌RUSTLAND荒野生存角色创建。真实3D边境人物与锈黑橙工业打字机界面中，鼠标依次选择风霜女性预设、女性体型、拖动下颌、选择深棕长卷发、穿上重型风衣并确认；每段只做一次明确的hover→click→result，禁连点和自动轮播。突出皮肤、发丝、皮革与布料物理，结尾转为金色夕照角色英雄镜头和RUSTLAND标识。

title.zh: 荒野生存角色创建 UI

description.en: Bedroom lighting, climate, and curtains flow into a coordinated Good Night routine with a warm, calm character.
description.zh: 从卧室灯光、空调和窗帘控制到晚安联动，呈现温暖平静的智能家居体验。

title.zh: 智能家居 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation, brand AURA smart home, retain "Sleep in Color. Wake in Calm." Enter the Bedroom from the Nuanju homepage to operate lights, air conditioners and curtains; disassemble the equipment card into a floating module and return it to its precise position, then select GOOD NIGHT to link the lights, curtains with the nighttime environment, and finally return to the AURA brand. Warm cream, soft amber and hygge rounded corner micro-motion effects, unified translucent dot triggers; it is forbidden to imitate existing smart homes, glass stacks, dark HUDs and neon.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，品牌AURA智能家居，保留“Sleep in Color. Wake in Calm.”。从暖居主页进入Bedroom，操作灯光、空调与窗帘；设备卡拆成悬浮模块再精准归位，随后选择GOOD NIGHT，让灯光、窗帘与夜间环境联动，最终回到AURA品牌。暖奶油、柔琥珀与Hygge圆角微动效，统一半透明圆点触发；禁仿现有智能家居、玻璃堆叠、深色HUD和霓虹。

title.zh: 智能家居 UI 动效

description.en: Pen tools, smart alignment, grouping, timeline control, color adjustment, and easing demonstrate a precise creative suite.
description.zh: 串联钢笔、智能对齐、编组、时间轴与曲线编辑，呈现专业创作工具的精确反馈。

title.zh: 创作编辑套件 UI 动效

prompt.en: For UI animation, brand Lumen creation and editing suite. In the dark charcoal grid, purple-pink-cyan aurora and unified glass panel, the Pen tool hover prompts, drag and drop card dual-axis smart alignment, multi-select and group, timeline play/drag/zoom, saturation adjustment and before-and-after comparison, Bezier curve selection Ease In-Out, and finally all panels exit and "Lumen / Motion & Design, Reimagined" is dropped. Motion effects are precise, professional, and triggerable to avoid hard cuts and cluttered panels.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，品牌Lumen创作编辑套件。深炭网格、紫粉青极光与统一玻璃面板中，依次展示Pen工具悬停提示、拖拽卡片双轴智能对齐、多选并Group、时间轴播放/拖动/缩放、饱和度调节与前后对比、Bezier曲线选择Ease In-Out，最后所有面板退场并落版“Lumen / Motion & Design, Reimagined”。动效精确、专业、可触发，避免硬切和杂乱面板。

title.zh: 创作编辑套件 UI 动效

description.en: Shared transitions move from plant care to coffee origins, showing continuous visual search and AI guidance.
description.zh: 从植物养护到咖啡风味识别，以共享转场展示视觉搜索与 AI 建议的连续体验。

title.zh: 视觉识别助手 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation, brand Loupe visual recognition assistant, keep "Look closer." First, scan the Monstera deliciosa, and the identification, conservation, similar products, and Ask AI actions will pop up, and the maintenance information and AI suggestions will be displayed; then scan the latte with a shared transition, and the Brew origin, Nutrition, Nearby cafes, and Ask AI will pop up, and the Ethiopian coffee information will be displayed and AI suggestions will be fed back, and finally Loupe will be launched. The white background is divided into mint green and warm orange, and is triggered by translucent dots. It is forbidden to imitate existing recognition apps.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，品牌Loupe视觉识别助手，保留“Look closer.”。先扫描龟背竹，弹出识别、养护、相似商品和Ask AI动作，展开养护信息与AI建议；再以共享转场扫描拿铁，弹出Brew origin、Nutrition、Nearby cafes、Ask AI，展开埃塞俄比亚咖啡信息并反馈AI建议，最后落版Loupe。白底薄荷绿与暖橙分区，半透明圆点触发，禁仿现有识别App。

title.zh: 视觉识别助手 UI 动效

description.en: Notes flip, rotate, and connect inside a thought nebula, making layered thinking and relationships tangible.
description.zh: 在思维星云中翻转、旋转并连接笔记节点，直观呈现分层思考与关系组织。

title.zh: 三维空间笔记 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animations, brand Strata three-dimensional space notes, and keep "Think in layers." In the dark blue-gray thinking nebula, hover the mouse over Today's Spark with parallax and click to enter the sub-node, flip Notes to view the content, drag the blank rotation space, and then connect Today's Spark, Project Ideas and Daily Notes, and finally the node exits and is replaced by Strata. Green-blue luminous cards, soft pink key nodes, arc-shaped connections and real depth of field, prohibiting flat signboards and cheap neon.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，品牌Strata三维空间笔记，保留“Think in layers.”。在深蓝灰思维星云中，鼠标以视差悬停Today's Spark并点击进入子节点，翻转Notes查看内容，拖动空白旋转空间，再连接Today's Spark、Project Ideas与Daily Notes，最后节点退场落版Strata。青蓝发光卡片、柔粉关键节点、弧形连线与真实景深，禁平面看板和廉价霓虹。

title.zh: 三维空间笔记 UI 动效

description.en: A real browser flow covers eyewear parallax, craftsmanship, color selection, and add-to-bag in an editorial luxury style.
description.zh: 在真实浏览器中完成墨镜视差、工艺浏览、配色切换与加购，呈现编辑杂志质感。

title.zh: 手工墨镜网站 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation, brand NOIR Tokyo handmade sunglasses, retain noir.com and "Vision, refined." The whole process simulates a real browser: the mouse controls the multi-layer parallax rotation of Hero sunglasses, scrolls through the craftsmanship and collection, hovers and clicks on The Pilot to enter the details, continues to rotate the product, switches the tortoise shell color and Add to Bag, and finally closes the browser and logs NOIR. The texture of the editorial magazine official website is carbon black, warm white and restrained gold. The English is clear and stable, and it is forbidden to imitate existing sunglasses brands, neon and glass.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，品牌NOIR东京手工墨镜，保留noir.com与“Vision, refined.”。全程模拟真实浏览器：鼠标控制Hero墨镜多层视差旋转，滚动浏览工艺与Collection，悬停并点击The Pilot进入详情，继续旋转产品、切换玳瑁配色并Add to Bag，最后关闭浏览器落版NOIR。炭黑、暖白与克制金色的编辑杂志官网质感，英文清晰稳定，禁仿现有墨镜品牌、霓虹和玻璃堆叠。

title.zh: 手工墨镜网站 UI 动效

description.en: Jazz-cover parallax, beat-responsive playback, and playlist actions create a soulful music-discovery website.
description.zh: 以爵士封面视差、节拍呼吸和播放列表操作，构建有灵魂的音乐发现网页。

title.zh: 音乐平台网页 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation, brand Aria high-end music discovery platform, retain aria.fm, "Sound, with soul." Real browser framework throughout: the mouse creates layered parallax on the Late Night Jazz cover, click play to make the cover and control bars breathe according to the beat; scroll through the music content, enter the album details and complete the playlist operation, and finally close the browser and launch Aria. It adopts the dynamic music magazine style of late night blue and black, warm white, warm orange and a small amount of soft pink. The interaction is synchronized with the music feedback, and it is forbidden to imitate the existing music platform, neon and cluttered interface.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，品牌Aria高端音乐发现平台，保留aria.fm、“Sound, with soul.”。全程真实浏览器框架：鼠标让Late Night Jazz封面产生分层视差，点击播放使封面与控制条按节拍呼吸；滚动浏览音乐内容，进入专辑详情并完成播放列表操作，最后关闭浏览器落版Aria。采用深夜蓝黑、暖白、暖橙和少量柔粉的动态音乐杂志风，交互与音乐反馈同步，禁仿现有音乐平台、霓虹和杂乱界面。

title.zh: 音乐平台网页 UI 动效

description.en: Gaze scans a coffee cup, opens flavor details, and adds an order through AR panels anchored to real objects.
description.zh: 通过凝视扫描咖啡杯、查看风味并加入订单，展示锚定现实物体的 AR 咖啡体验。

title.zh: AR 眼镜咖啡馆 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation and wear AR glasses to enter the warm light cafe in the first person. Scan the coffee cup with your gaze to launch the Single Origin Ethiopia and Order, Details, and Save actions; open the flavor details and identify the book, weather, and today's special drink at the same time; gaze at Add to Order and a shopping bag and coffee holographic model will appear, and finally raise your eyes to exit the interface and display the Aria brand. Cards must be anchored to real objects and change with the viewing angle. They must be translucent white with warm orange. Voice, neon, and floating UI separated from objects are prohibited.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，第一人称佩戴AR眼镜进入暖光咖啡馆。凝视扫描咖啡杯，展开Single Origin Ethiopia与Order、Details、Save动作；打开风味详情，同时识别书本、天气和今日特饮，凝视Add to Order后出现购物袋与咖啡全息模型，最后抬眼让界面退场并显示Aria品牌。卡片须锚定现实物体并随视角变化，半透明白配暖橙，禁语音、霓虹和脱离物体的漂浮UI。

title.zh: AR 眼镜咖啡馆 UI 动效

description.en: Short presses gather and long presses scatter soft organic particles into fireflies, fish, seeds, shells, and feathers.
description.zh: 用短按聚合、长按分散，让柔和有机粒子变成萤火虫、小鱼与自然收藏物。

title.zh: 治愈收集游戏 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation, brand Bloom healing collection game, keep "Tap to bloom." In the warm beige picture book interface, short-press the mouse to aggregate circles, water droplets, and heart-shaped particles into fireflies, and long-press to disperse them; then aggregate small fish, seeds, shells, and feathers to make multiple creatures float gently together, and finally exit and release Bloom. Use low-saturated Morandi colors, handwritten titles, rounded 2D organic particles and piano xylophone sound effects. All movements are triggered by the mouse. 3D, dark, neon and static displays are prohibited.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，品牌Bloom治愈收集游戏，保留“Tap to bloom.”。在暖米白绘本界面中，鼠标短按把圆形、水滴与心形粒子聚合成萤火虫，长按将其分散；随后聚合小鱼、种子、贝壳和羽毛，让多个生物共同轻柔漂浮，最终退场落版Bloom。使用低饱和莫兰迪色、手写标题、圆润2D有机粒子与钢琴木琴音效，所有运动由鼠标触发，禁3D、深色、霓虹和静态展示。

title.zh: 治愈收集游戏 UI 动效

description.en: Type, icons, and geometric components expand, split, and reassemble to the beat into a futuristic motion poster.
description.zh: 让字体、图标与几何组件随节拍扩张、拆分和重组，最终形成未来动态海报。

prompt.en: Do UI animation and create experimental digital vision driven by music: in a minimalist graphic space, let the interface, shapes and lines move according to the beat; dynamic fonts expand, split, rotate and deform with the music, icons, symbols and multi-layer components are combined simultaneously to ultimately form a futuristic dynamic poster. Integrating fashion technology, kinetic typography and professional AE dynamic graphics, the rhythm is clear, the transition is smooth, and static UI display is prohibited.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，创作音乐驱动的实验性数字视觉：在极简图形空间中，让界面、形状和线条按节拍运动；动感字体随音乐扩张、拆分、旋转和变形，图标、符号与多层组件同步组合，最终形成未来感动态海报。融合时尚科技、kinetic typography与专业AE动态图形，节拍明确、转场流畅，禁止静态UI陈列。

description.en: Scans activate tactical HUD, map, radar, and character modules before mechanical motion assembles a complete game menu.
description.zh: 扫描启动战术 HUD、地图、雷达与角色模块，经机械合并组装成完整游戏菜单。

prompt.en: Make UI animations and create original AAA cyber game system interface. The scanning beam activates the multi-layered tactical HUD in the dark space, unfolding the status panel, map, circular radar, character information and energy modules; after the camera goes deep, the player operates the panel, icons, technical diagrams and system modules, the windows slide and merge at high speed, the 3D model is rotated, the data stream is connected, and finally assembled into a complete game menu. It uses mechanical animation, controlled glitches, particles, and cinematic lenses, retains original placeholder technical text, and prohibits real game logos.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，打造原创AAA赛博游戏系统界面。扫描光束在暗色空间启动多层战术HUD，展开状态面板、地图、圆形雷达、角色信息与能量模块；镜头深入后由玩家操作面板、图标、技术图与系统模块，窗口高速滑动合并，3D模型旋转、数据流连接，最终组装成完整游戏菜单。采用机械动画、克制故障、粒子与电影级镜头，保留原创占位技术文字，禁真实游戏Logo。

description.en: Paper, frosted glass, and dark-red guide lines deconstruct an operator record into a dimensional classified-magazine poster.
description.zh: 以纸张、磨砂玻璃和暗红引导线拆解角色档案，重组为立体机密杂志海报。

prompt.en: Make UI animations and create future military character archive-style game PVs, not technology HUD or software interfaces. Dark gray paper, frosted glass, off-white typesetting and dark red guide lines form a high-level secret magazine that is dismantled into a three-dimensional space: first the huge number "08" and OPERATOR RECORD appear, and then the relationship modules of character identity, organizational status and abstract abilities are unfolded along the red line, and then the paper and glass layers are reorganized into a three-dimensional character archive poster. Emphasize editing layout, white space, paper grain and parallax shuttle, and prohibit ordinary attribute bars and complex backgrounds.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，制作未来军事角色档案式游戏PV，不做科技HUD或软件界面。深灰纸张、磨砂玻璃、米白排版与暗红引导线组成一本被拆入三维空间的高级机密杂志：先出现巨大编号“08”与OPERATOR RECORD，再沿红线展开人物身份、组织状态和抽象能力关系模块，随后纸张与玻璃层重组为立体角色档案海报。强调编辑排版、留白、纸张颗粒和视差穿梭，禁普通属性栏与复杂背景。

description.en: Album vinyl, timeline scrubbing, lyrics, playlists, and audio settings form a complete music-responsive desktop experience.
description.zh: 从专辑黑胶到时间轴、歌词和音频设置，呈现完整且响应音乐的桌面体验。

title.zh: 桌面音乐软件 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animations and create high-end desktop music software. In the editing interface of carbon black, cream, silver, crimson and gold, hover the mouse over the music library and album card, select the album and the cover expands to reveal the slowly rotating vinyl; continue to select the playlist, drag the timeline, cut songs and adjust the sound, so that the waveform, lyrics and music information respond naturally, and then go through the collection, artist, playlist creation and audio settings, and finally combine it into a complete music experience. Glass panels and vinyl are used only as exquisite material elements, and no overpowering or cheap animation effects are allowed.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，创作高端桌面音乐软件。炭黑、奶油、银色、深红与金色的编辑式界面中，鼠标悬停音乐库和专辑卡，选中专辑后封面扩展并露出缓慢旋转的黑胶；继续选择歌单、拖动时间轴、切歌与调节声音，让波形、歌词和音乐信息自然响应，再穿行收藏、艺人、歌单创建和音频设置，最终组合为完整音乐体验。玻璃面板与黑胶只作精致材质元素，禁喧宾夺主和廉价动效。

title.zh: 桌面音乐软件 UI 动效

description.en: A mysterious object moves from physical scan to wireframe, CAD, and exploded view before returning as a refined design archive.
description.zh: 将神秘物体从实物扫描转为线框、CAD 与爆炸图，再重组为高级设计档案。

prompt.en: Make UI animations and analyze a mysterious 3D object with future industrial design files. The black-and-white and gray interface is paired with thin blueprint lines and a small amount of red. The physical object is first scanned and identified, and coordinates and engineering marks appear. Then the surface is converted into wireframes, CAD drawings and technical sketches. The components enter a three-dimensional exploded view, and the camera passes through the structure and connections. Then the blueprint and real materials are re-integrated, finally forming an advanced title screen with edited fonts. Maintain the rational, precise, and artistic quality of research documents, and prohibit traditional holographic HUDs, cheap cyberspace, and messy data.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，以未来工业设计档案分析一个神秘3D物体。黑白灰界面配细蓝图线与少量红色，先扫描识别实物并出现坐标与工程标记，再把表面转成线框、CAD图和技术草图；组件进入三维爆炸视图，镜头穿过结构与连线，随后蓝图和真实材质重新融合，最终形成带编辑字体的高级标题画面。保持理性、精密、艺术化的研究文档质感，禁传统全息HUD、廉价赛博与杂乱数据。

description.en: A card dragged into the workspace triggers panels, connections, charts, and layers across one coherent SaaS workflow.
description.zh: 跟随卡片拖入工作区，引发面板、连接、图表与图层联动，展现完整产品路径。

title.zh: SaaS 产品使用路径动效

prompt.en: Make UI animations and create modern SaaS product ads, focusing on showing a complete usage path rather than a list of functions. The camera follows the card and drags it into the workspace, triggering the movement of relevant panels, the generation of connections, and the rearrangement of information chains; it continues to delve into button state switching, component replacement, chart response, and layer combination, and finally zooms out to show that all digital workspaces flow into a unified ecosystem. It adopts Linear minimalism, Figma product demonstration feel, intelligent micro-interaction and fluid transition, and prohibits static screenshots, PPT page cuts and function lists.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，创作现代SaaS产品广告，重点表现一次完整使用路径而非功能清单。镜头跟随卡片拖拽进入工作区，引发相关面板移动、连接生成和信息连锁重排；继续深入按钮状态切换、组件替换、图表响应与图层组合，最后拉远展示所有数字工作空间流动为统一生态。采用Linear式极简、Figma产品演示感、智能微交互和流体转场，禁静态截图、PPT切页与功能罗列。

title.zh: SaaS 产品使用路径动效

description.en: Touch, rotation, growth paths, and form editors nurture a moonlit fox familiar toward its awakened appearance.
description.zh: 通过触摸、旋转与成长编辑器，培养固定形象的月光小狐并预览觉醒形态。

title.zh: 魔法使魔 App UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation and fix the 3D fox with lavender fur, golden eyes, crescent moon on the forehead, cloud tail and transparent wing fins in the Magic Academy Magic App. Touch it to reveal the card and respond, drag and rotate to observe; open the BOND/GROWTH path to complete growth and select the badge; enter the AURA, MARK, CHARM, and FORM editors to switch halos, ornaments, and forms, display the awakening preview, and finally release FORM YOUR BOND. Moonlight blue and purple, warm ivory, soft gold, glass and parchment textures, no combat, weapons, imitation Pokémon or Hogwarts.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，魔法学院使魔App中固定淡紫毛、金眼、额头月牙、云尾与透明翼鳍的3D小狐。触摸让它探出卡片并回应，拖拽旋转观察；打开BOND/GROWTH路径完成成长并选择徽章；进入AURA、MARK、CHARM、FORM编辑器切换光环、饰物和形态，展示觉醒预览，最终落版FORM YOUR BOND。月光蓝紫、暖象牙、柔金、玻璃与羊皮纸质感，禁战斗、武器、仿宝可梦或霍格沃茨。

title.zh: 魔法使魔 App UI 动效

description.en: A text-free specimen system examines veins, roots, and growth stages while a climate dial compares plant conditions.
description.zh: 用无文字图标观察叶脉、根系与生长阶段，并通过气候圆盘比较植物状态。

title.zh: 植物标本生长系统 UI

prompt.en: Make UI animations and create a high-end plant specimen and growth desktop system with no text. Using forest green, parchment, brass and museum natural science textures, select the pressed leaf specimen with the mouse, check the leaf veins with a magnifying glass, and then switch the structure, color palette and root system with icons; drag the growth ring to allow natural changes from seeds, seedlings to adult plants, operate the climate disk to change the light and humidity, and use dividing lines to compare dry and moist conditions. Finally, the leaves, growth rings and specimen needles are used to form an abstract emblem. No letters, numbers, fake text, neon, and passive documentary footage are allowed.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，创作完全无文字的高端植物标本与生长桌面系统。以森林绿、羊皮纸、黄铜和博物馆自然科学质感，鼠标选择压叶标本，用放大镜检查叶脉，再以图标切换结构、色板与根系；拖动生长环让种子、幼苗到成株自然变化，操作气候圆盘改变光照与湿度，并用分割线比较干燥和水润状态，最后以叶片、年轮和标本针组成抽象徽记。禁止任何字母、数字、伪文字、霓虹和被动纪录片镜头。

title.zh: 植物标本生长系统 UI

description.en: A text-free interface switches materials, places furniture, and compares morning-to-evening light in a premium interior workflow.
description.zh: 以无字界面完成材质切换、家具拖放和晨昏照明对比，构建高端室内方案。

title.zh: 室内设计平台 UI 动效

prompt.en: UI animation, original high-end interior design platform ATELIER, no text in the entire film except the final brand name. In the interface of warm ivory, limestone grey, dark olive, walnut and brass, select indoor items with the mouse and switch to real materials such as walnut and travertine; drag in leisure chairs and floor lamps, use magnetic alignment and effective/invalid feedback to complete the placement, then operate the wordless lighting disc to change morning light to warm sunset, and drag the dividing line to contrast the effect. Finally, the control exits, leaving only the completion space and the static ATELIER. Browser bars, fake text, SaaS billboards, and passive building roaming are prohibited.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，原创高端室内设计平台ATELIER，除最终品牌名外全片无文字。暖象牙、石灰岩灰、深橄榄、胡桃木与黄铜界面中，鼠标选择室内项目，切换胡桃木、洞石等真实材质；拖入休闲椅和落地灯，用磁性对齐与有效/无效反馈完成摆放，再操作无字照明圆盘改变晨光到暖夕阳，并拖动分割线对比效果。最终控件退场，只保留完成空间与静止ATELIER。禁浏览器栏、伪文字、SaaS看板和被动建筑漫游。

title.zh: 室内设计平台 UI 动效

description.en: A blueprint builds the cabin, linking navigation, autonomy, energy, and drive modes before a high-speed hero shot.
description.zh: 从工程蓝图生成座舱，联动导航、自动驾驶、能源与驾驶模式后驶入高速场景。

title.zh: 汽车空间系统 UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation, car space system AURORA DRIVE OS, retain "DRIVE BEYOND THE ROAD." Generate the body and cockpit from the engineering blueprint, activate the NAVIGATION route, AUTONOMOUS environmental scanning, ENERGY power network, CABIN control and DRIVE MODE collaboration, and then go out of the cockpit to show the high-speed Hero Shot. Black, silver, ice blue with energy green and warm orange. The UI must have real thickness and integrate into the car space. It is forbidden to imitate existing car machines, two-dimensional screens, cheap neon and dynamic typing.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，汽车空间系统AURORA DRIVE OS，保留“DRIVE BEYOND THE ROAD.”。从工程蓝图生成车身与座舱，激活NAVIGATION路线、AUTONOMOUS环境扫描、ENERGY动力网络、CABIN控制和DRIVE MODE协同，再穿出驾驶舱展示高速Hero Shot。黑银冰蓝配能源绿与暖橙，UI须有真实厚度并融入汽车空间，禁仿现有车机、二维屏幕、廉价霓虹和动态打字。

title.zh: 汽车空间系统 UI 动效

description.en: Physical icons guide underwater loadout, armor modes, sonar discovery, and route deployment toward a submerged ruin.
description.zh: 以物理图标完成深海装备安装、模式切换、声呐探索和路线部署，准备进入遗迹。

title.zh: 深海生存游戏 UI 动效

prompt.en: UI animation for the original deep-sea survival tactics game ABYSS//ECHO, which had no text at all before final release. Fixed the black deep sea skeletal soldier, using the physical icon in the underwater deployment cabin to complete the equipment preview, wrong slot rejection, correct drag installation and cancellation; switch the shield, propulsion and balanced armor modes, use sonar to discover the structure; drag the submarine route to avoid danger and lock the entrance to the ruins, and finally display the deployment confirmation through the failure of letting go and the successful long press, open the hatch and set off. Titanium black, ice blue, ivory white and restrained amber, hard surface mechanical UI, banned text and numbers, flat cards, cheap holograms and passive trailers.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，原创深海生存战术游戏ABYSS//ECHO，最终落版前完全无文字。固定黑色深海外骨骼士兵，在水下部署舱用物理图标完成装备预览、错误槽位拒绝、正确拖拽安装与取消；切换护盾、推进和平衡装甲模式，以声呐发现结构；拖动海底路线避开危险并锁定遗迹入口，最后通过松手失败与长按成功展示部署确认，开启舱门出发。钛黑、冰青、象牙白与克制琥珀，硬表面机械UI，禁文字数字、平面卡片、廉价全息和被动预告片。

title.zh: 深海生存游戏 UI 动效

description.en: Purple neon awakens a cyber helmet and neural scan as layered HUD, data flows, and restrained glitches complete the boot.
description.zh: 紫色霓虹唤醒赛博头盔与神经扫描，多层 HUD 经数据流和克制故障完成启动。

prompt.en: Make UI animations and create a cyber nervous system startup film. Among the black metal, hot pink purple neon, dots, scan lines and restraint glitches, the purple light awakens the cyber helmet and SYSTEM ONLINE, DATA CONNECTED, NEURAL SCAN; the multi-layer HUD unfolds, and the cursor selects the module to trigger the scanning ring, data flow, alarm, geometric deformation and component reorganization, and the lens passes through the interface, ultimately forming "NEON SYSTEM / FUTURE RIOT". Keep 2D graphics with 3D depth, be fast but precise, and ban random drifting windows and cheap glitches.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，打造赛博神经系统启动片。黑金属、热粉紫霓虹、网点、扫描线与克制故障中，紫光唤醒赛博头盔及SYSTEM ONLINE、DATA CONNECTED、NEURAL SCAN；多层HUD展开，光标选中模块后引发扫描环、数据流、警报、几何变形与组件重组，镜头穿越界面，最终形成“NEON SYSTEM / FUTURE RIOT”。保持2D图形与3D纵深、快速但精确，禁随机漂窗和廉价故障。

description.en: A robot initializes from wireframe, exposes head mechanics, power, and sensors, then reassembles for a launch reveal.
description.zh: 机器人由线框初始化并展开头部机械、能源与传感器，最终归位完成发布定版。

prompt.en: Make UI animation, brand NEURAL SYSTEM future robot launch film. In the black interface, white engineering lines and purple scanning light, the robot is initialized by the wireframe, and the technical panel connects the mechanical structure, energy core and hardware modules; the cursor selects the head to enter the exploded view, showing the internal machinery, circuits, energy sources and sensors. The data flows along the connection lines. Finally, the components are returned and the "NEURAL SYSTEM / NEXT GENERATION" is printed. Blending industrial blueprints, Swiss typography and advanced product visualization, it bans game HUDs, fantasy, cartoons and cluttered holograms.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，品牌NEURAL SYSTEM未来机器人发布片。黑色界面、白色工程线与紫色扫描光中，机器人由线框初始化，技术面板连接机械结构、能源核心与硬件模块；光标选择头部进入爆炸视图，展示内部机械、线路、能源和传感器，数据沿连线流动，最后组件归位并落版“NEURAL SYSTEM / NEXT GENERATION”。融合工业蓝图、瑞士排版与高级产品可视化，禁游戏HUD、幻想、卡通和杂乱全息。

description.en: A golden retriever responds from its card while grooming, health, and care services build a lively pet-care experience.
description.zh: 金毛犬从卡片中回应触摸，并通过洗护、健康与服务目录完成活泼护理体验。

title.zh: 宠物护理 App UI 动效

prompt.en: Make UI animation and create a bright pet care app. In the creamy rice, turquoise, soft orange, coral pink and lavender color sticker interface, the golden retriever pokes out from the pet card and wag its tail and tilt its head in response to the touch; swipe up to expand SPA, GROOMING, HEALTH, and CARE services. After clicking, bubbles, water droplets, towels, combs, and cleaning feedback appear, and then it switches to the service catalog, and finally "LOVE YOUR BEST FRIEND / CARE EVERY DAY" is published. Elements are triggered by interaction, and static posters, complex signboards, medical sense, darkness and cyber style are prohibited.
prompt.zh: 做UI动画，创作明快的宠物护理App。奶油米、青绿、柔橙、珊瑚粉与薰衣草色贴纸界面中，金毛犬从宠物卡探出并摇尾、歪头回应触摸；上滑展开SPA、GROOMING、HEALTH、CARE服务，点击后出现泡泡、水滴、毛巾、梳子与清洁反馈，再转为服务目录，最终落版“LOVE YOUR BEST FRIEND / CARE EVERY DAY”。元素由交互触发，禁静态海报、复杂看板、医疗感、暗黑和赛博风。

description.zh: 在极简工业空间追踪女舞者锋利而多变的肢体线条，让视觉框线随节拍响应。

title.zh: 工业空间舞者追踪动效

prompt.en: Dancer TD dynamic tracking. Minimalist industrial large space: cement gray floor, pure white walls, top skylight. A woman with short hair wears a black bodysuit and performs an experimental modern dance alone in the center of the frame. The movements are characterized by large lateral extension of the arms, raising upwards and overhead, squatting with a low center of gravity, sliding sideways on one leg, raising the head and arms, probing and twisting the trunk, and rapid direction switching. The limbs have sharp lines and a strong sense of geometry. They frequently switch between standing, squatting, lunging, and side extension, and the rhythm is relaxed. 130 BPM, hard kick drum base, distorted synthesizer bass, and occasional crash cymbals. It has a strong mechanical feel and is synchronized with the tension of the dance in the picture. Red/cyan wireframe, horizontal screen 16:9, 15 seconds
prompt.zh: 舞者TD动态追踪。极简工业大空间：水泥灰地面、纯白墙面、顶部天窗。一名短发女性身着黑色紧身连体衣，独自在画面中央跳实验性现代舞。动作大幅度快速方向切换为特征，130 BPM，硬 kick 鼓底，失真合成器贝斯，偶有 crash 镲片，机械感强、和画面里舞蹈的张力同步。红/青色线框，横屏16:9，15秒

Dancer TD dynamic tracking. Set in a concrete underground space, a short-haired man dressed in black performs a solo dance at the center, with long, slender limbs. Add red and cyan wireframe-style TD dynamic tracking effects.

舞者 TD 动态追踪。场景位于一处混凝土地下空间，一名黑衣短发男子在中央独舞，四肢线条修长。加入红色与青色线框风格的 TD 动态追踪视觉效果。

prompt.en: td style: night surveillance camera flash capture scene: on the dark grass, the moment two dogs were caught barking by the security camera.
